mechanism.base: Old texts have it that metal keeps to the stone and is born where the ground stays damp. Ore does not form in the open. It waits under the hill, pressed by rock and fed by slow water, for longer than anything struck from it lasts. Earth gives the blade its substance first and its patience second, and a blade that forgets the ground it came from loses the second gift first.
mechanism.catalyst_turn: With too little Earth, the edge stands on thin ground and every judgment is struck before it has settled. Let one hard question sit overnight and answer it tomorrow.
mechanism.friction_turn: With too much Earth, the ore sits in the ground long after it is ready and no edge gets struck from it. Make one thing and let it leave the house.

function.definition_catalyst: Your Mind is where the world soaks in and becomes yours. Earth makes it steady, so what you learn sinks in. As a catalyst, the ground runs short, and new things pass through before they settle. You take longer than most to trust what you learn.
function.definition_friction: Your Mind is where the world soaks in and becomes yours. Earth holds it, and nothing you learn is lost. As a friction, the holding never stops, and you take in far more than you ever act on. You stay put well past the time to move.
function.definition_balanced: Your Mind is where the world soaks in and becomes yours. Earth makes it steady, so what you learn sinks in. In balance, what you take in settles at a steady pace. You trust what you learn and still let new things in.
function.advise_catalyst: What you take in needs time to settle before it holds your weight. Bring one half-done job from last year to its end this month. Write down one thing each week that you now know for sure, and keep the list.
function.advise_friction: Seek Wood, the Action energy. Wood draws on the ground it grows from and turns what it takes into something built. Let it spend what Earth stores. You stay with what you already know rather than put it to use. Send the rough draft before the clean one exists. Try a new method on a familiar problem.
function.advise_balanced: What you take in settles at a steady pace, and your judgement holds while each new thing gets time to sink in. Bring one half-done job from last year to its end this month. Write down one thing each week that you now know for sure, and keep the list.

candidates.cta_verdict: Because you would rather understand a thing than be quick about it, you keep only the answers you gave time to.

catalyst.clause: the edge stands on thin ground and every judgment is struck before it has settled
catalyst.remedy: Let one hard question sit overnight and answer it tomorrow.

friction.clause: the ore sits in the ground long after it is ready and no edge gets struck from it
friction.remedy: Make one thing and let it leave the house.

wide.clause: There is no shortage of Earth in you, the slow ground the metal grows from.
wide.remedy: Use it. Settle one question you already know enough about.

missing.clause: Nothing feeds the metal here, so each judgment comes out with no time in the ground behind it.
missing.remedy: Borrow it from someone older, one slow conversation at a time.

spared.clause: There is no Earth here to pile on the metal, and the metal is lighter for it.
spared.remedy: Leave it be. Keep deciding at your own speed.

thin.clause: Only a little Earth sits on the metal, enough to steady it and not enough to slow it.
thin.remedy: Keep it that small. Study only what you will use.

excess.clause: Earth piles past what the metal uses, so the edge stalls where it lies and nothing gets struck.
excess.remedy: Put one thing out this month, rough as it is.

catalyst.clause: The mine goes hungry: a fine stone with nothing behind it, brilliance spent faster than it forms.
catalyst.remedy: Rest and study are the polishing, not stalling.

friction.clause: The setting closes over the stone: so much preparation that the jewel never leaves the box.
friction.remedy: Take it out and wear it somewhere real.

excess.clause: Too much earth buries the metal: talent that never surfaces, thought that never becomes a cut.
excess.remedy: Take it out of the box. Cut one thing.

mechanism_yin.base: Metal is born of earth, the old texts say: it lies in the mountain, gathered in stone, grown by slow pressure and the moisture of deep ground. Nothing hurries it. The mountain holds the ore for ages before any stone is cut from it, and every jewel remembers the patience of the rock that made it.
mechanism_yin.catalyst_turn: Run thin, the mine goes hungry: a fine stone with nothing behind it, brilliance spent faster than it forms. Your chart asks you to feed the ground. Rest and study are the polishing, not stalling.
mechanism_yin.friction_turn: Run heavy, the setting closes over the stone: so much preparation that the jewel never leaves the box. Comfort begins to bury what it formed. Take it out and wear it somewhere real.

__ore.retired_fn_body: The Root is your learning function: the seat where the world soaks in and becomes yours. With Earth running it, your mind absorbs like sediment: slowly, in layers, keeping everything that settles. You are slow to learn and nearly impossible to unteach. Give ideas time underground. What forms there comes out ore-grade, load-bearing, and permanently yours.
__ore.retired_base_personal: Your core is Metal, and Earth feeds Metal: ore grows in the mountain. Everything solid and patient in your life is the ground your edge is mined from. Sleep, routine, teachers, home: that is Earth doing its slow work on you. That is why Earth is your Mind, the slow intake that restores what the cutting spends. A blade is only ever as good as the mountain behind it.
__ore.retired_v3_definition_catalyst:
Earth is your Mind, and as a catalyst, it is how you take things in: slowly, thoroughly, and for keeps. Sleep, routine, teachers, home: everything steady in your life feeds it. You learn best with time and repetition, and your judgment gets sharper the longer you sit with a question.

Patient, thorough, hard to argue with. You are the one who rereads the message before replying, distrusts a first reaction on principle, and remembers what everyone else forgot. People bring you things to check because your slowness is really carefulness wearing work clothes.

Depth is simply patience given enough seasons. So give every big decision one night. Read before deciding, reread before committing. Once a season, pull out an old certainty and test whether it still holds.
__ore.retired_v3_definition_friction:
Earth is your Mind, and as a friction, it is intake with no off switch: more courses, more research, more preparing, while the doing keeps waiting. Absorbing starts to feel like progress, and it is the safest way to stand still.

Seventeen open tabs and no draft. A shelf of notebooks with three pages used. Advice collected from everyone and acted on from no one. Careful has quietly become cautious, cautious has become stuck, and the next step has been known for a while now.

At some point more learning is just fear with a syllabus. Trade study for evidence: for every hour in, one thing out that someone else can see. Give the thing you keep researching a decision date. Finish one old course before any new one gets your card.

backlog_dips_tg_pattern.body: Real rest is part of the studying: sleep and routine are where the layers set.
